description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart labeled “Stimulus Type” that shows the distribution of stimulus categories used in the study, with 10 slices in total; the slices are labeled around the ring with percentages and are colored distinctly: Draft/Other is shown in dark red at 26.4%, Press Release in mustard yellow at 18.7%, External News Article in dark green at 18.1%, Interview in dark navy at 8.8%, Organizational Report in purple at 7.7%, Event Posting in dark maroon at 6.6%, Organizational Website in light purple at 4.9%, Email in light green at 2.7%, Social Media Post in orange at 1.1%, and an additional small blue slice labeled “Intra-agency” whose percentage is not visible in the provided image. There is no separate legend; instead, category names and percentages are printed outside the donut, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, with the segments arranged around the circle without an explicitly stated ordering.
